title: Manyhands JSON v1 setup preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of a pull-request repo enable: the repository is registered with no configuration and its setup is recorded, committed on the remote's primary and published as a branch for a pull request. The remote is not contacted until the confirmed request runs.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: What the enable will do: the repository's root, the primary branch, the identity, the short code prefix, the mode the configuration sets, the setup remote's name and location (redacted), and the forge.

source.description: Where the identity comes from: supplied with the request, or the level of Git configuration that holds it.

written_locally.description: Whether the command writes the identity to the repository's own Git configuration. No other configuration is written.

remote_location.description: The remote's fetch location, redacted. Null when it has none.

forge.description: The forge setting the configuration will hold. Null when the request supplies none.
